# Card effects: documented functions (`duel_effects`)

Reference table generated in the documentation round of 2026-10-31 and extended in the round of 2026-11-03. Each row is a function that reached the `documented` stage (`docs/PROGRESS.md`): its prototype, purpose, return value, side effects and callers, read from the Ghidra decompilation with the names of that round. The same text is the function's plate comment in Ghidra (`re/documented*.tsv`, applied by `tools/ghidra/ApplySignatures.java`). How the subsystem works as a whole is in [`../duel_effects.md`](../duel_effects.md); pointers to structures are typed `void *` and the structure is named in the summary.

Functions: 2749 (rel_duel_eng 2748, rel_duel_mgr 1).

| `0x09bfe224` | `uint duel_effects_get_controlling_side(uint side, int slot, int mode)` | Works out which side controls the card in field slot (side, slot) after control-changing effects. Starts from the slot's switch bit (byte +1 bit 6 of 0x09e2a55c + side x 0xb3c + slot x 0x14) xor bit 0 of its flags word +0x10, then walks the slot's effect-record list (head u16 +0x0a, 10-byte records at 0x09e2c7cc): equip links (kind 10) from 0x1edf, 0x13ea, 0x1877, 0x169a, 0x1466 or 0x1322 hand control to the equip card's side (unless mode is 1 or the equip is disabled or blocked by duel_effects_get_spell_immunity), 0x1c37/0x15e6 restore the base bit in mode 1; source links (kinds 6-7) from 0x1c84, 0x1be4/0x1a9c and 0x1df0/0x18bf-0x18c2 give control to the source side unless duel_effects_has_monster_immunity_against or duel_effects_is_unaffected_by_traps protects the card (the last group also needs a shared attribute, duel_core_monster_has_attribute); temporary/lasting records (kinds 1 and 5) of control-changing cards (duel_effects_is_control_changing_card) take the side from bit 0 of the record value (0x1da4, 0x1da2, 0x19c0, 0x1925, 0x11cf store the original side, inverted), flip-kind-1 sources being ignored while 0x148e or 0x14da is active. When card 0x1632 is active (subject to duel_effects_get_trap_immunity) the walk is skipped. Returns the controlling side bit for mode 0/1, and for mode 2 the side that took control (0xffffffff when none) (hypothesis for the mode meanings, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 13 (ai_rate_slot_threat, duel_core_enforce_slot_controller, duel_effects_resolve_140c, duel_effects_resolve_1668, ...); exported (2 import stubs without callers). |

| `0x09ccc718` | `int duel_effects_is_valid_ritual_tribute(void *ctx, uint side, int location, uint index)` | Whether the card at (side, location, index) may be Tributed for the Ritual Summon in progress. The ritual monster is entry u16 +0x08 of the ritual table 0x09dec4d4; u16 +0x0a is the number of tributes chosen so far (their instances in the extra-target ring 0x09e28e50), 0x09e28f64 the Level total still to cover and 0x09e28f68 the smallest tribute Level used (0xff before the first). Hand (location 0x0b): only the summoner's own monsters, not the ritual monster itself unless a second copy is in hand, and, for the first tribute, only when a monster zone is free. Field (location + index < 5): the slot must be tributable by the summoner (duel_core_can_tribute_slot), not unaffected by spells, face-up when on the opponent's side; when no zone is free the first tribute must be an own monster whose zone becomes usable (duel_core_is_zone_usable_lenient). Already chosen cards return 0; Level-0 cards return 0. A first tribute 0x1c14 of the ritual monster's attribute returns 1 at once. For 0x1ac2, 0x19d9, 0x1716 and 0x1698 the minimum Level is 1 (exact total). A tribute that leaves an excess smaller than the minimum Level is accepted (1); otherwise it collects up to 42 Levels of the remaining hand monsters and tributable field monsters and returns duel_effects_ritual_level_search(levels, n - 1, remaining - level, min_level). No side effects. Callers: 3 (duel_effects_filter_ritual_tribute, duel_effects_select_filter_ritual_tribute, duel_effects_can_ritual_summon_entry). |
